main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). The premier racing venue in southern Tasmania. Built with a 28-metre wide StrathAyr profile, it is a spacious, modern, and fair galloping track. The defining feature is the 350m home straight with a distinct, gradual uphill gradient that tests stamina in the final furlong and exposes one-dimensional front-runners.
main_turf.post_bias: Plays fairly across all distances due to the wide track layout. However, in large fields over 1100m and 1200m, horses drawn wide (10+) must possess tactical speed to cross and find cover before the uphill drag.

handicapping_angles.the_uphill_stamina_test: The uphill straight stops weak front-runners dead in their tracks. Heavily upgrade 'Swoopers' (closers) with proven stamina and strong late sectionals. Horses dropping back in distance (e.g. 1600m to 1400m) frequently out-finish horses stretching out.
handicapping_angles.the_strathayr_drainage: Because the track features a premium StrathAyr sand profile, it drains exceptionally well and handles winter weather better than standard provincial tracks. Do not aggressively upgrade extreme mudlarks unless rated Heavy 8 or worse.
handicapping_angles.victorian_mainland_shippers: Local Tasmanian elite form is competitive, but respect horses shipping over from the Victorian mainland (Flemington, Caulfield, Moonee Valley, Geelong, Ballarat) as they carry a distinct class edge (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.hobart_cup_summer_carnival: During the February Hobart Cup (2400m) carnival, track quality elevates to Group/Listed grade. Factor in higher par offsets for Cup day feature races.
